The recorded canonical command produced 3107 bytes and SHA-256 6a53f7ffc241801032e21dae011a3e1c6502446827b7e82c7fbcbaec3562ce9a, byte-identical to the two-section stored patch; logical stats are 2 files, 62 insertions, and 4 deletions.

handleFile is the asynchronous callback receiving the fresh error and buffer. Each retry must call fs.readFile(file.originalPath, handleFile); invoking handleFile directly would neither retry I/O nor supply a buffer and would make the later buffer.length path invalid.

The reviewer raised the callback-selection concern on original commit 2789bf57. The author clarified it by renaming handleFile to readFileCallback without changing control flow, supporting the protected-pattern comparison rather than a defect label.
